summary.zh-TW: 以現金 {{money:param.amount}} 支付外包的服務費用。
summary.en: Pay {{money:param.amount}} in cash for outsourced services.

message.zh-TW: 帳上現金不夠付這筆款項。
message.en: There is not enough cash on the books for this payment.

explanation.zh-TW: 請外部廠商做事的費用在服務完成時就認列，屬於銷管費用；現金同時減少。它不會留下可以用很多年的資產，所以不像設備那樣資本化。
explanation.en: The cost of work done by an outside supplier is recognised when the service is delivered and belongs to distribution costs and administrative expenses; cash falls at the same time. It leaves no asset that can be used for years, so unlike equipment it is not capitalised.
